title: Lok Sabha Passes Bill to Increase Supreme Court Judge Strength from 33 to 37
summary: Expands Apex Court judicial capacity to tackle case pendency and constitute Constitutional Benches.

blocks.title: 📰 4. 🌐 NATIONAL, STATE & INTERNATIONAL NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 Lok Sabha Passes Bill to Increase Supreme Court Judge Strength from 33 to 37. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Expands Apex Court judicial capacity to tackle case pendency and constitute Constitutional Benches.
Passed **Supreme Court (Number of Judges) Amendment Bill, 2026** amending the 1956 Act.
Sanctioned Strength Expansion: Increases SC Judges from **33 to 37** (excluding CJI).
Total Strength with CJI: **38 Judges** (37 Judges + 1 CJI).
Judge strength excluding CJI (**37 judges**) vs total strength including CJI (**38 judges**).
